overlay.waiting_hint: Press {ask} to answer what was just said, or type a question above.
overlay.no_screenshot: Screenshots need grim (Wayland), spectacle, or maim/scrot (X11)
overlay.drop_cv: drop a PDF here to add a CV
overlay.no_context_hint: Open Settings → Interview and add your CV, or write about yourself in About me.
overlay.shot_off: Screenshots are turned off in Settings
overlay.no_vacancy_hint: No vacancy yet: Settings → Interview to paste it and to add the CV you sent.

dialog.title: Settings
dialog.docs_intro: Files the coach reads before every answer: your CV, a LinkedIn export, a cover letter, a portfolio. PDF, DOCX and text work. You can also drop files on the interview window.
dialog.vacancy_intro: The vacancy you are interviewing for. Pick one from the pipeline (its prepared CV is attached too) or paste the text or a link.
dialog.paste_vacancy: Paste the vacancy text or a link…
dialog.notes_hint: Anything the coach should know: salary expectations for this role, topics to avoid…
dialog.about_intro: Your ABOUT.md: the facts every answer is built from. Edit it here; it is saved to the file.
dialog.layout_lines: Lines to say, then the detailed answer
dialog.full_answer: Show the detailed answer (main answer, key points, practical context)
dialog.language_note: Answers are written in the interview language. Speech recognition uses it too.
dialog.default_output: Automatic: follows the output that plays the call
dialog.speech_note: Bigger models are more accurate and slower. A new model downloads on first use.
dialog.vision_hint: Optional. A fast model that understands images answers a screenshot much sooner: some free models need 10 to 40 seconds. Empty means the model above.
dialog.deepgram_note: Deepgram hears the call (and your microphone when it is on): the audio leaves this computer. Live captions send each growing sentence again, so billed audio is about 3–4 times the speech. DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in .env works too.
dialog.cloud_note: {name} gets your CV, your ABOUT text and each question with every request. Enter its API key, load the list of models and choose one.
dialog.model_note: Switchyard runs on this computer and needs no key. Keep the model on auto, or load the list and choose one.
dialog.shot_none: No capture tool found. Install grim (Wayland, e.g. niri or sway) or spectacle; maim or scrot on X11.
dialog.shot_note: The window turns transparent while the screen is captured. The image goes to the vision model through the gateway.
dialog.reset_ask: Restore every setting to its default?
dialog.prepare_intro: Get ready before the call. The question bank lists what this interviewer is likely to ask, with first-person lines to say. The CV review compares your CV with the vacancy.
dialog.cv_review: Review my CV for this vacancy
dialog.prepare_empty: Nothing yet. Build the bank or review your CV.
dialog.review_gaps: Gaps and how to address them
dialog.need_context: Add your CV or write about yourself first.
dialog.project_intro: Pick the folder of a project you will defend. The AI reads it once and writes a dossier: architecture, key modules, decisions, weak spots and likely questions. After that every answer about the project comes from the dossier and the code that matches the question, so it is quick.
dialog.project_missing: The folder is gone; the saved dossier still works.
dialog.project_asking: Read {n} files. The AI is studying them…
dialog.project_dossier: Dossier (edit it to correct a fact, then Save changes)
dialog.project_cloud: {name} receives the files of this folder once, for the analysis, and the dossier with every question. Keys, tokens, passwords, .env files and binaries are left out.
dialog.project_confirm: Send the files of “{folder}” to {name} for analysis?
dialog.interview_hint: Each interview keeps its own vacancy, CV and notes. ABOUT.md is shared.
dialog.delete_ask: Delete this interview with its vacancy, notes and documents?
